name: MATH 3630
title: Long-Term Actuarial Mathematics I
description: Mathematical foundations of life contingencies and their applications to quantifying risks in other actuarial contexts. Topics include long-term insurance products, survival and longevity models, life tables, life insurance, life annuities, premium calculations, reserves.
requirement_description: MATH 3160 or 3165 or STAT 3375Q; MATH 2620. Cannot be taken for credit after passing MATH 3631 or 5630.
